notes:
Critical update: improved download and installation flow.

• Critical alerts start downloads directly, without opening the manual update page.
• Follow download progress and cancel from the bottom of the main UI.
• A redesigned update page shows release notes, percentage, and downloaded size.
• Moagram explains Android installation permissions and opens the installer when you grant permission and return.
• Verified downloads and pending installation requests survive app restarts.
critical_message: An important update fixes download progress and Android installation-permission handling. Please update to Moagram preview 5 for the improved update experience.
